prompt:
Check one candidate model relation against sentences of a long engineering document. Unit ids show the order of the sentences in the document; the sentences come from different places.

Candidate: Slot Allocation Engine provides "by the Slot Allocation Engine" to Slot Coordinator (an information or material flow).

Evidence sentences used to propose the candidate:
S067: The proposed Airport Acceptance Rate is tested against the demand profile to identify overloads, underused capacity, and points where a Ground Delay Program may become necessary.
S068: The Slot Coordinator uses the Slot Allocation Engine to prepare an initial slot feasibility view but does not publish binding Calculated Takeoff Time values during baseline construction.
S839: The Performance Analytics Warehouse shall calculate delay absorption as the portion of expected airborne or terminal-area delay that is converted into controlled ground delay before departure.
S840: Delay absorption shall be measured by comparing the unconstrained demand predicted by the Demand Prediction Service with the regulated demand produced by the Slot Allocation Engine and the realized movement times captured through the Flight Data Exchange.

Other sentences of the same document that mention this item, a similarly named item, or another element that produces or sends such an item:
S015: The Slot Allocation Engine supports fair and traceable allocation of constrained departure and arrival opportunities when demand exceeds available capacity.
S031: Within the boundary, the Demand Prediction Service, Capacity Assessment Module, Slot Allocation Engine, Airport CDM Portal, and Digital Briefing Room support planning and collaborative assessment.
S080: The Slot Coordinator maintains accountability for Calculated Takeoff Time allocation policy and confirms that the Slot Allocation Engine applies the current Business Rules Registry parameters.
S134: The Slot Allocation Engine converts accepted constraints into Calculated Takeoff Time values and Target Off Block Time guidance for affected flights.

S575: The Slot Allocation Engine treats an unresolved customs hold as a reason to avoid assigning an aggressive departure sequence position to the affected flight.
S603: The Slot Allocation Engine preserves equity by distributing delay across operators according to the active Ground Delay Program logic and local priority rules.
S625: Slot Allocation Engine uses these constraints when evaluating whether a Calculated Takeoff Time should be offered, retained, exchanged, or released.
S659: Slot Allocation Engine retains the Calculated Takeoff Time until the operational delay exceeds the tolerance defined in the Business Rules Registry.
S669: The Slot Allocation Engine evaluates the candidate swap against active Ground Delay Program constraints, Calculated Takeoff Time integrity, Target Off Block Time dependencies, and Airport Acceptance Rate commitments.
S671: The Slot Coordinator reviews any exception raised by the Slot Allocation Engine and confirms whether the swap remains consistent with regional flow objectives.

Answer "supported" only if the document states that Slot Allocation Engine produces or sends this item AND that Slot Coordinator receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence), and no other sentence shows that the item Slot Coordinator uses comes from a different producer or is a different item with a similar name. Answer "unsupported" if the sentences describe different items, the wrong elements, the opposite direction, or if another producer of the item the consumer uses is stated. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"unsupported","reason":"The candidate item \"by the Slot Allocation Engine\" is not a real item; the document only says the Slot Coordinator uses the engine as a tool (S068, S404) and reviews its exceptions (S671), so no specific output the engine produces is shown being received by the Slot Coordinator."}
